entries.zh: 小篮；篮、簋一类小型盛器（底物谓此属器物）
entries.en: small basket; a basket- or gui-type small container

entries.zh: 箪；竹篾编成的小圆篮（圆曰箪，方曰笥）
entries.en: small round basket woven of cane/bamboo strips
chicken coop; basket or cage for carrying hens
fish basket; basket used for catching fish

entries.zh: 花篮；盛花之篮（西栏作玫瑰之篮）
entries.en: flower basket (Spanish column: basket of roses)
baskets and hampers for storing things

entries.zh: 存物之篮；篮筛（第二字笞、筛两可）
entries.en: storage basket; basket(-sieve), the second character written 笞 but read variably in the manuscript
entries.notes: 缩写 p̃ 展开为 para 依赖推断；第二字字形罕见且 M/R 两栏音读不一致，疑为筛之俗写，词义据西栏与首字篮定为存物之篮。

entries.en: to cease; to stop; to rest

entries.zh: 厌倦；餍足（西栏释止，取倦而止之义）
entries.en: to weary of; to be sated (Spanish column glosses: to cease)
entries.notes: M 栏声调号污损（T99）；西语 cessar 与厌（厌倦、餍足）对应较松，据字义与两栏音读从宽定为倦止义。

entries.en: (of water) to cease and run out; to subside
entries.notes: M 栏音写与息字及 R 栏音写均不合，词目身份存疑；语义据西栏（cessar, acabarse la agua）与汉字息定为水止息义。

entries.zh: 茶；煎饮之茶（词头西文残损，所指细节存疑）
entries.en: tea; boiled-tea drink (Spanish headword garbled, detailed sense uncertain)
entries.notes: 词头拼写无法确解，汉字栏恭与 M、R 两栏音写不合，疑为茶字之误辨；据两栏音写与下条煎饮语境定为茶义。

entries.zh: 清明茶；谓清明前后所采之茶，煎而饮之味甚佳
entries.en: Qingming tea; tea picked around the Qingming festival, whose boiled water is drunk and said to be very good
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑：荼/茶]（荼为茶之古写，此处取茶），M 栏声调号污损（T99）；[疑]与 T99 并见，按规程降为低置信。

entries.zh: 缯艚（罾艚）；罾网捕鱼之渔船
entries.en: net-fishing junk; boat using a square lift-net (缯 used for 罾)
entries.notes: 缩写 p̃ 展开为 para 依赖推断；缯通罾（方形抬网），缯艚即罾网渔船。

entries.zh: 艚；大海船、货船（西栏作大船）
草艚；草篷草织之海船（西栏却释作大船）
entries.en: a 'grass' boat, a Fujian vessel type; the Spanish column glosses it as a large junk
entries.notes: R 栏音写与草艚不合，西语 grande 之称与草艚（草篷小船）亦有出入；词目依汉字与 M 栏定为草艚船名。

entries.zh: 罟艚；拉网捕鱼之渔船（罟即渔网）
entries.en: seine-net fishing junk; a boat used for fishing
entries.notes: M 栏中段标[残]（音写不全，疑为多音节词目）；词目依汉字罟艚与西栏语义定为捕鱼渔船。

entries.zh: 杉板（舢板）；华人大船，西语 champan 一名源此
entries.en: sampan; a Chinese vessel — origin of the loanword 'champan', glossed as a large junk

entries.zh: 绫艚；捕鱼用渔船（或与牵网捕鱼相关，船制不详）
entries.en: a fishing boat (Spanish column: boat for fishing); vessel type uncertain
entries.notes: 缩写 p̃ 展开为 para 依赖推断；绫艚船名罕见，或指牵网（牵绫）渔船，无从确证。
